articles.title: Securitize CEO says tokenized stocks could unlock a $5 trillion crypto market
articles.snippet: At a panel at ETHConf, Carlos Domingo argued that bringing stocks and exchange-traded funds onchain could unlock a market far larger than today's roughly $30 billion tokenized asset sector.

articles.title: Trad.Fi, W3 target $650 million in onchain private credit using AI evaluation
articles.snippet: Equipment-financing lender Trad.Fi is working with W3 to automate capital workflows and bring real-economy business lending onto public blockchain rails.

articles.title: Ethena lands Janus Henderson backing as asset manager invests in ENA, eyes USDe distribution
articles.snippet: The deal underscores the trend of traditional asset managers backing DeFi infrastructure, following BlackRock's Uniswap and Apollo's Morpho investments.

articles.title: Come back after the summer, says one analyst on crypto markets
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's growing divergence from tech stocks raises concerns as AI spending surges, says Quinn Thompson.

articles.title: A16z, Paradigm lead $175 million bet to move global credit markets onchain
articles.snippet: Morpho secured $175 million from Paradigm, a16z crypto and Ribbit as the lending protocol seeks to become foundational infrastructure for onchain credit markets.
